facts.title: Stargate Universe — Internet Movie Firearms Database
exactExcerpts: Lieutenant Matthew Scott and Master Sergeant Ronald Greer
MSgt. Greer with an M4, showing Eli how to use it
facts.location: G36K section, lines101–116; M4A1 section, lines118–130 of the returned page
facts.fact: Both men use the G36K; an M4 is also explicitly shown with Greer. The M4 section describes genuine Colt M4A1 and Olympic Arms variants, with season1 Time/Sabotage examples.
facts.selectedAdaptation: Greer uses an M4A1 throughout the new32/base16/partner16 family; Scott uses a G36K throughout his32/base16. No assertion that either carries only that weapon in all episodes.

facts.fact: The page also documents Young with an UMP and a holstered P14, and Scott using the UMP in Water. Those other source scenes are acknowledged; the chosen Young kit is protective command support, not a firearm attack.

facts.title: Face à face / Sateda — transcript VO, Atlantis saison3
exactExcerpts: firing with energy and barreled pistols
facts.fact: Sheppard and Teyla fire P90s in this episode; Ronon uses energy and conventional weapons during the rescue. McKay also works with the Jumper readout and radio. Selecting bantos for Teyla and technical support for McKay is a role adaptation, not a claim that they never use guns.

facts.fact: Young assigns field command to Scott, and Rush works on Destiny controls and systems. Civilian Chloe is part of the stranded group. The guard/buff radio actions are authored bounded adaptations of human guidance, not verified episode-specific named attacks.
